# AstroDeck

> Free, open-source (MIT) Astro starter kit for building websites with a coding agent. Download it, open it in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI or Windsurf, and describe your site. The agent follows a guided workflow (intake, brief, cleanup, config, theme, pages, verify, vibe2prod audit, handover) and the result is checked by `npm run verify` and the bundled vibe2prod audit.

AstroDeck is an Astro 7 + Tailwind CSS 4 + React 19 + shadcn/ui project. Agents read AGENTS.md (the always-loaded index) and the portable Agent Skills in .agents/skills/. The site brief lives in PROJECT.md, brand and navigation in src/config/site.ts, design tokens in src/styles/globals.css (written by `npm run theme`).

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://www.astrodeck.dev/docs): Getting started, build-site workflow, brief, site config, theme, sections and pages, demo cleanup, verify, vibe2prod, supported agents, MCP, deploy, Astro 7 notes, migrating from 3.x
- [Full documentation for LLMs](https://www.astrodeck.dev/llms-full.txt): AGENTS.md plus the README in one plain-text file
- [Changelog](https://www.astrodeck.dev/changelog): Release history

## Building blocks

- [Sections](https://www.astrodeck.dev/sections): Page sections (Hero, HeroGradient, HeroSplit, Features, Pricing, Testimonials, CTA, ContentBlock, LogoCloud, IntegrationGrid, FAQ, Stats, Team, Comparison, Newsletter, Contact) with registry usage snippets
- [Components](https://www.astrodeck.dev/components): shadcn/ui React components (Button, Card, Badge, Input, Label, Accordion, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Select, Tabs, Tooltip)
- [Pages](https://www.astrodeck.dev/pages): Demo pages (SaaS, startup, portfolio, contact, blog, docs, login, sections, changelog, content)
- [Component registry](https://github.com/holger1411/astrodeck/blob/main/src/registry.json): Machine-readable catalog of every section, layout and UI component with props, use-when hints and examples

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/holger1411/astrodeck): Source code, issues, releases
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/holger1411/astrodeck/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Index for coding agents (rules, commands, task to skill)
- [Skills](https://github.com/holger1411/astrodeck/tree/main/.agents/skills): astrodeck-build-site, astrodeck-new-page, astrodeck-new-section, astrodeck-theme, astrodeck-cleanup, vibe2prod
- [Latest release](https://github.com/holger1411/astrodeck/releases/latest): Download

## Optional
